provenance.text_editability: Ordinary source labels are live text; selected mathematical fonts are native outlines. Source image inserts retain internal raster pixels.
provenance.image_reconstruction: Each source raster instance is isolated with complete source SVG ancestry, source clipping, mask and paint order. No full-figure image is used.
extraction_warnings_reviewed: Source image/shading warnings resolved by isolated source SVG inserts preserving alpha, clip and paint order. Source pixels and final reconstruction preview inspected side by side; original native paths retained. Rotated ordinary labels restored as single native text boxes. Source clipping is preserved for images; crop-crossing background paths omitted. PowerPoint dash length/cap rendering uses closest native preset.
